issues.explanation: Chapter 36 immediately calls 单福 “徐庶,” although Chapter 35 established only the alias 单福. The later passage then presents 徐庶’s true identity as a revelation, creating a premature identity disclosure and redundant handoff.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep calling him 单福 until 程昱 reveals that he is 徐庶, or explicitly identify “单福（即徐庶）” at the start and remove the later reveal.
